learning_outcomes.text: Frame molecular property prediction as a learning problem
Featurise molecules for regression and classification
Build and tune QSAR and graph-based models
Evaluate models with appropriate chemistry-aware metrics
Define and respect a model's applicability domain
Interpret models and communicate predictions honestly

integrative_case: A discovery team wants to prioritise compounds by predicted toxicity: a trainee must featurise the molecules, build and tune a QSAR model with leakage-free validation, define its applicability domain, and present predictions with honest uncertainty to guide which compounds to test.
